headword: {社員食堂|しゃいんしょくどう}

definitions.gloss: employee cafeteria; company canteen; staff dining hall
definitions.explanation: A dining facility within a company or office building that serves meals to employees, typically at subsidized prices.

examples.japanese: {昼|ひる}は{社員食堂|しゃいんしょくどう}で{食|た}べる。
examples.english: I eat in the employee cafeteria at lunch.

examples.japanese: うちの{社員食堂|しゃいんしょくどう}は{安|やす}くて{美味|おい}しい。
examples.english: Our employee cafeteria is cheap and delicious.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいオフィスビルには{社員食堂|しゃいんしょくどう}が{完備|かんび}されている。
examples.english: The new office building is fully equipped with an employee cafeteria.

notes:
A compound of {社員|しゃいん} (company employee) and {食堂|しょくどう} (dining hall/cafeteria). Often abbreviated to {社食|しゃしょく} in casual workplace conversation. Many Japanese companies provide subsidized meals in their cafeterias as an employee benefit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社員食堂|しゃいんしょくどう}で{食|た}べる — to eat in the cafeteria
- {社員食堂|しゃいんしょくどう}のメニュー — the cafeteria menu
- {社員食堂|しゃいんしょくどう}が{充実|じゅうじつ}している — the cafeteria is well-equipped

RELATED WORDS:
- {社食|しゃしょく} — company cafeteria (casual abbreviation)
- {学食|がくしょく} — university/school cafeteria (same abbreviation pattern)
- {食堂|しょくどう} — dining hall, cafeteria (general term)
